comments.content: CRITICAL BUG: `poolPath` is referenced but NEVER declared in `markGoKeyDead`. It should be `goPoolDbFile(sessionId)`. Because `poolPath` is an undeclared name, it throws a ReferenceError (or a compile error TS2304 in strict TypeScript). The throw is swallowed by the surrounding `catch { /* best-effort */ }`, so the function appears to succeed but the post-write file-permission hardening (chmod 0600 on the pool DB and its -wal/-shm sidecars) NEVER executes after a dead-mark write. This directly contradicts the stated W9 hardening contract and leaves SQLite WAL/SHM sidecar files (which may contain the redacted-but-still-sensitive `reason` column) at a less-restrictive umask-derived mode until the next `db()` call re-hardens them. Fix: declare `const poolPath = goPoolDbFile(sessionId);` before the hardening block.
